actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 0 (Roll no. 72). (text: CR H1196)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 0 (Roll no. 72). (text: CR H1196)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H1213)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 359.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H1196-1197)
Mr. Babin moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Energy officials and congressional committees receiving the mandated reports.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall submit to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology... a report

dimensions.assessment: Imposes a routine administrative and reporting requirement rather than altering underlying project execution.
dimensions.evidence: submitting a report on the use by the Department... of the authority to reduce or eliminate cost-sharing requirements

dimensions.assessment: The source does not indicate any changes to federal spending or revenue.
Amends the Energy Policy Act of 2005 to add a specific reporting subsection.
dimensions.evidence: Section 988 of the Energy Policy Act of 2005 is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Mandates ongoing quarterly reporting requirements indefinitely.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 120 days after the date of the enactment of this subsection and at least quarterly thereafter

missing_information: Administrative costs associated with compiling the required reports.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Energy to submit quarterly reports regarding the reduction or elimination of nonfederal cost-sharing requirements for certain projects.
